Maya Chen: 20 minutes to go. Quick sanity check: livestream health, recorder, deck sync? Any hot swaps we should prep?
Eli - AV: Camera 1 firmware prompted an update overnight; I rolled it back to the previous stable and locked settings. Levels look good.
Lin (SRE): Recorder is green. We saw a transient NIC flapping on the room switch earlier; moved the presenter VLAN to a different port. Streaming endpoint tested.
Aisha - Product: Moved the Dedicated timeline to a single slide; will call out the pilot without deep details per Chris request. Also added a short FAQ line for latency/cost tradeoffs.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Order update: leadership -> infra -> roadmap -> customer Q&A. If infra runs long, we'll trim roadmap to highlights.
Chris - CEO: I'll keep leadership remarks <7min and point to the AMA doc for deeper questions.
Eli - AV: If OBS freezes, two quick options:
1) ssh into av-box and run `systemctl restart obs`
2) if that fails, switch RTMP to the backup encoder (encoder-b) via the console and continue recording locally.
Lin (SRE): Copying runbook shortcut: `/runbooks/stream-fallback` (pinned). If CPU on inference-prod spikes during the live demo, deploy-bot will pause autopromote.
recorder-bot: Local file captured. Upload scheduled to s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/2805120000/session-part1.mp4
Maya Chen: Presenters, please use wired ethernet and mute when not speaking. I'll post the slide link and the final speaking order in 10m.
Aisha - Product: One Q to flag for leadership: "how should customers choose between Dedicated and Private for compliance-first deployments?" Will queue during Q&A.
Chris - CEO: I'll tackle compliance strategy high-level; Product can add specifics.
Maya Chen: Awesome. Any other blockers?
Eli - AV: None here. Ready to roll. :camera_flash:
